warm_wav.scope: 12 warmed repeated-public 10-second WAV uploads; latency only, not accuracy
warm_wav.method: Read models/demo/genuine.wav PCM; repeat/truncate in memory to 320000 PCM bytes, wrap in 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV with scripts.check_demo.wav, create 12 sessions, time authenticated upload calls via scripts.check_demo.upload; nearest-rank p95.

resources.limitations: Sampled values, not continuous peaks; CPU percentage is relative to one logical CPU. Not physical capture-to-alert or minimum hardware evidence.
